calls.reason: The only evidence is Anthropic's short learning study on quiz mastery. It does not measure prior incompetence, getting through workplace checks, or defects in shipped code.

METR supports the view that productivity effects are unclear. The burden half rests on Harness's own vendor survey, which shows correlation and does not establish that code volume causes company-wide strain.

A June 2026 preprint with released code reports an agent completing 51% of 300 tasks on 136 real websites without step-by-step help. That contradicts the categorical claim that such agents do not or cannot exist.
The billing-migration premise is explicitly unconfirmed. ITPro reports high token bills but no matched evidence on cost per engineer or labour replacement at the same employers.

ServiceNow's own January 2026 disclosure describes sellers using a Claude-powered coaching tool tied to company data, and a company-wide Claude Code rollout. These are concrete uses, not just vague partnership announcements.

No matched figures for subscriber compute costs against subscription revenue were found for either company. Epoch's whole-company spending estimate cannot test the $3–$15 range or the claim that growth depends on it.
